# Xgenious — Custom Software Development Company

## Free Open Source Software

Xgenious publishes free, MIT-licensed, self-hosted software anyone can download, fork, and deploy.

### Genius School Management
Free school ERP system. Laravel 11 + React 18. 19 modules: student admissions, attendance, fees, exams, payroll, library, transport, hostel, inventory. Multi-school support. MIT licensed.
- Landing page: https://xgenious.com/free-software/genius-school-management
- License: MIT
- Stack: Laravel 11, React 18, Inertia.js, MySQL/PostgreSQL
- Target users: Schools, colleges, NGOs, software agencies

### Genius CRM
Free self-hosted CRM. Laravel 12 + React 19. 12 modules: contacts, leads, deal pipeline (Kanban), tasks, company profiles, RBAC, REST API, 2FA, Docker.
- Landing page: https://xgenious.com/free-software/genius-crm
- License: MIT
- Stack: Laravel 12, React 19, Inertia.js, MySQL
- Target users: Solo founders, small sales teams, developers, agencies

### Genius HRM
Free open-source HR management system. Laravel 13 + React 18. 13 modules: employees, payroll, attendance, leave, recruitment (ATS), performance management. 6 roles, 55 permissions.
- Landing page: https://xgenious.com/free-software/genius-hrm
- License: MIT
- Stack: Laravel 13, React 18, Inertia.js, MySQL, shadcn/ui
- Target users: SMEs, HR teams, developers, agencies

## Premium Scripts & Marketplace Products

### Xilancer — Freelancer Marketplace Script
Complete self-hosted freelancer marketplace script. Build a Fiverr or Upwork clone. One-time purchase, no monthly fees, full source code.
- Product page: https://xgenious.com/products/xilancer-freelancer-marketplace-script
- Demo: https://xilancer.xgenious.com
- Purchase: https://codecanyon.net/item/xilancer-all-in-one-freelancer-marketplace-platform/
- Stack: Laravel (PHP 8.1+), Vue.js, MySQL, Flutter (mobile apps), Stripe & PayPal escrow
- Rating: 4.36/5 on CodeCanyon · 45 reviews · 10,000+ installs
- Pricing: Regular $59 · Bundle $149 · Complete Package $282 (all one-time)
- Includes: Gig marketplace, project bidding, escrow payments, real-time chat, native Android/iOS apps, admin panel, multi-language + RTL support
- Keywords: freelancing platform script, fiverr clone script, upwork clone laravel, laravel freelancer marketplace

### Prohandy — On-Demand Service Marketplace Platform
Complete self-hosted on-demand service marketplace. Build a TaskRabbit, UrbanClap, or Handy clone. Works for any service vertical: home services, beauty, automotive, pet care, fitness, events, home improvement, personal assistance. One-time purchase, no monthly fees, full source code.
- Product page: https://xgenious.com/products/prohandy-on-demand-home-service-marketplace
- Demo: https://prohandy.xgenious.com
- Purchase: https://codecanyon.net/item/prohandy-on-demand-home-service-marketplace-platform/55091770
- Stack: Laravel 12, Flutter 3.32, MySQL, Google Maps, Firebase push notifications
- Rating: 5.0/5 on CodeCanyon · 6 reviews · 73+ sales
- Pricing: Regular $39 (one-time) · Extended $149 (one-time, SaaS rights)
- Includes: Client Flutter app, Provider Flutter app, Laravel admin panel, real-time live chat, cart-based booking, job posting + hiring flow, identity verification, coupon system, provider wallet + withdrawals, 19 payment gateways (PayPal, Stripe, Razorpay, Paystack, Flutterwave, Mollie, Midtrans, Cashfree, Instamojo, Mercado Pago, Zitopay, Square, CinetPay, PayTabs, Billplz, Toyyibpay, PayFast, Paytm, Manual), social login (Google, Facebook, Apple), multilingual, dark/light theme
- Keywords: on demand home service marketplace script, laravel flutter marketplace, taskrabbit clone script, urbanclap clone, handy clone script, service booking platform
